predecessors.name: Kadamba dynasty
predecessors.text: the Kadamba kingdom of Banavasi, which Pulakeshin I took over (Chalukya page footnote: 'overpowered his overlord in c.

successors.name: Rashtrakuta dynasty
successors.text: the Chalukya remnant of the south that Dantidurga's Rashtrakuta successors took; Kirtivarman II 'retained control over his southern provinces up to the year 757'

successors.name: Eastern Chalukyas
successors.text: Vengi, the coast of Andhra from Visakhapatnam to Guntur held after the conquest of the Vishnukundina kingdom (Pulakeshin II page: 'Vishakhapatnam to Nellore and Guntur')

ledger.x: 543: Pulakeshin I founds the Chalukya dynasty at Vatapi.
602: a step in the Pallava border.
616: Pulakeshin II conquers the eastern Deccan.
739: the Arabs invade the Lata country.
739: the Umayyad army is beaten, the frontier holds ('fought and defeated an Umayyad army in 739 CE').

c. 742: Vikramaditya II enters Kanchipuram. 'The road to Kanchipuram lay open and Vikramaditya II entered the city victorious'; the page gives no year ('after 734'; earliest mention the Narwan plates of 21 December 741 or 742), so the year is the plates', a bridging date.

c. 744: the Chalukya raid on Kanchi is over. 'The final invasion of Kanchipuram happened in the final years of the reign of Vikramaditya II' (reign 733-744); Dantidurga 'helped Nandivarman II to recover Kanchi' (undated). No land held.
750: Dantidurga holds Malwa and south Gujarat.

wars.name: Pulakeshin II's war with Harsha
wars.outcome: Chalukya victory: Harsha 'advanced up to the Narmada River before being forced to retreat'; the Narmada became the frontier.

wars.name: Chalukya conquest of Vengi
wars.outcome: Chalukya victory: Pishtapura captured, a battle near Kunala Lake (Kolleru), the Vishnukundina kingdom conquered and Kubja Vishnuvardhana made governor.

wars.name: Pallava-Chalukya war under Pulakeshin II
wars.outcome: Pulakeshin II's drive reached Kanchipuram with setbacks at Pariyala, Suramara and Manimangala; Narasimhavarman I then took Vatapi in 642 and held it for thirteen years until Vikramaditya I retook it in 655.

wars.name: Vikramaditya I's wars with the Pallavas
Vikramaditya II's Pallava campaigns
wars.outcome: Raids on Kanchipuram around 730 and after 734 (Nandivarman II, aged thirteen, failed to stop them); no annexation on the page.

wars.name: Arab invasion of Lata
wars.outcome: The Chalukya governor Pulakeshin Avanijanashraya 'fought and defeated an Umayyad army in 739 CE'.

wars.name: Rashtrakuta overthrow of the Chalukyas
wars.outcome: Dantidurga took Madhya Pradesh and Gujarat by 750, defeated the Chalukyas in 753, and Kirtivarman II held the south until 757.

certainty.note: No treaty or survey line exists on the pages.
